company.name: Styra
company.shortDescription: Styra offers a platform that allows companies to enforce and monitor authorization policies across cloud-native applications.
company.description:
Styra offers a platform that allows companies to enforce and monitor authorization policies across cloud-native applications. Styra delivers a fully managed Open Policy Agent platform with a built-in library of policies that allow customers to implement authorization policy-as-code. Prerunning supports the monitoring and validating of policy changes before committing, mitigating risk predeployment. Meanwhile, declarative models outline the desired state to prevent security drift and eliminate errors before they occur.

Styra works with cloud-native APIs to define, enforce, and keep tabs on policies before runtime. The platform takes in a business context and outputs security decisions across namespaces and clusters, letting customers write policy once and enact it where necessary.

aiResearchSummary.text: Styra is researching methods for defining code-based policies through graphical user interfaces, as described in 'Graphical user interface and system for defining and maintaining code-based policies.' The company is also developing techniques for partial policy evaluation and authorizing API calls, as seen in 'Partial policy evaluation' and 'Method and apparatus to reduce the window for policy violations with minimal impact.' Additional work includes viewing aggregate policies and validating policies and data in API authorization systems. These areas reflect Styra’s focus on policy management and API authorization.
